name: kg_repoint_edge
description: Move one endpoint of an existing edge to a different node, keeping the edge row (id, sentence, evidence linkage, provenance) intact. The drain op for Disambiguation attachment points: once the true referent of an attached edge is determined, re-point it from the Disambiguation node to the referent. Audited: requires a non-empty `reason`, refuses user-locked edges and user-locked old/new endpoint nodes, refuses self-loops and duplicate-creating re-points, and snapshots before/after into kg_revision_log so the change can be reverted. Pass `dry_run: true` to preview without committing.

inputs.name: edge_id
inputs.description: UUID of the edge to re-point.

inputs.name: new_source_id
inputs.description: New source node UUID. Omit to keep the current source. At least one of new_source_id / new_target_id is required.

inputs.name: new_target_id
inputs.description: New target node UUID. Omit to keep the current target.

inputs.name: reason
inputs.description: Why this re-point is correct. Goes into kg_revision_log.

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.description: Preview the re-point; do not commit. Default false.

outputs.description: {ok, revision_log_id, before, after} on commit; {ok, dry_run, before, after} on dry_run.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for kg_repoint_edge:
- edge_id (required): UUID of the edge to re-point
- new_source_id / new_target_id (at least one required): the new endpoint node UUID(s); omit the one you keep
- reason (required): why this re-point is correct
- dry_run (optional): preview only
- finding_id (optional): source finding row id

Example:
{
    "edge_id": "edge-abc-123-def-456",
    "new_target_id": "node-789-xyz",
    "reason": "Edge was attached to the 'Alex's Sister' Disambiguation; context identifies Mary as the referent"
}
